title: Two-sided insertion adjunctions under a finite product equivalence
statement: Let C be a preadditive category with finite biproducts, J a finite type, and D_i preadditive categories with zero objects. Equip the product category with a preadditive structure. Let E : C ≌ ∏_i D_i be an equivalence with additive inverse. If e_i : D_i → C is left adjoint to the i-th component of E, then that component is also left adjoint to e_i. These adjunctions can be chosen so that the first units are invertible, their composites with the second counits are identities, all off-diagonal restrictions of e_i are zero, and the map from K to the biproduct of e_i(E_i K) formed by the second units is invertible. This includes J empty.

source.place: Tag 04TS, finite clopen gluing; the elementary finite-product Hom and biproduct calculation in step 4 of lem-pur-clopen-common-compact-support.

proof.text: In the product category define s_i by the identity in coordinate i and a zero object elsewhere. A map s_i M → N, or N → s_i M, is uniquely determined by its i-th component. These identifications are natural, giving s_i ⊣ ev_i ⊣ s_i with mutually inverse diagonal unit and counit. The coordinate projections and inclusions form a finite biproduct bicone with identity vertex. Transport both adjunctions and the bicone through E and its inverse. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies s_i composed with E inverse with the given e_i. Transport the right adjunction through this isomorphism. The unit comparison for uniqueness of left adjoints proves the diagonal normalization; the transported bicone has projection maps exactly the right-adjunction units, so the displayed biproduct lift is an isomorphism. For the empty family the product category is the zero category and the same empty bicone argument applies.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenProductAdjoints {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C] {J : Type*} [Finite J]
    (D : J → Type*) [∀ i, Category (D i)] [∀ i, Preadditive (D i)]
    [∀ i, HasZeroObject (D i)]
    [Preadditive (∀ i, D i)]
    (E : C ≌ ∀ i, D i) [E.inverse.Additive]
    (e : ∀ i, D i ⥤ C)
    (a : ∀ i, e i ⊣ E.functor ⋙ Pi.eval D i) :
    ∃ b : ∀ i, E.functor ⋙ Pi.eval D i ⊣ e i,
      (∀ i, IsIso (a i).unit) ∧
      (∀ i M, (a i).unit.app M ≫ (b i).counit.app M = 𝟙 M) ∧
      (∀ i k, i ≠ k → ∀ M, IsZero (((E.functor ⋙ Pi.eval D k).obj ((e i).obj M)))) ∧
      ∀ K, IsIso (biproduct.lift (fun i ↦ (b i).unit.app K))
